title: Performance Evaluation and Verification Module Implementation

paragraphs: The performance evaluation module in the ScholarPredict system is implemented using Python's scikit-learn library. The module calculates various metrics to evaluate the accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, and confusion matrix of the Random Forest classifier model. The implementation details are as follows: - Target Platform: Python Machine Learning Workstation - Framework / Language: Python / scikit-learn / OpenCV - Deployment / Tooling: pip / conda - Computational Subsystems & Components: Image Preprocessing Pipeline: Image normalization, resizing, and illumination correction (OpenCV / PIL) - Feature Extraction Engine: Handcrafted visual descriptor computation (Color Histograms & GLCM) (scikit-image / NumPy) - KNN Classification Engine: Instance-based distance calculation and majority-vote prediction (scikit-learn) - Dataset Management Subsystem: Dataset ingestion, label encoding, and train/test partition (pandas / File System) - Performance Evaluation Module: Model metrics and validation matrix calculation (scikit-learn.metrics) - Implementation Considerations: Modular code separation, exception handling, and input validation. High computational efficiency, vectorized operations, and reproducible execution.
